d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav ke rujhanon men endie ko bari barhat milti dikh rahi hai. vahin dusri taraph mahagathbandhan kaphi pichhe nazar aa raha hai. bihar chunav ke ye natije kya hairan karne vale hain. chunav se pahle aur us dauran bihar ke daure par rahe bibisi sanvaddataon ne vahan kaisa mahaul dekha tha. usi par vo apna nazriya bata rahe hain.
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
